$comment: NEW. The information architecture already offers « J'en connais déjà » at first run (§C.2) but nothing behind it existed. This is that. It must be fully spoken, skippable at any point, and it must never tell a learner she failed — it only chooses a starting point, and « Commencer au début » stays one tap away on every screen of it.

design.form: adaptive ladder, 3 rungs, max 12 items, ~4 minutes
design.abandonPolicy: quitting at any point starts her at L01 with no message about the test
design.resultMessage: « Tu peux commencer ici. » + the lesson title. Never a score, never a level name.

guardrail: A placement result NEVER locks earlier lessons. Everything before the entry point is marked `available`, not `completed` — she can go back, and the Parcours shows the earlier lessons as open, not as skipped.
